result.title: Find the Clue, Not the Scene: Rethinking Reasoning for Entity Recognition in Vision-Language Models
result.summary: Answering a knowledge-based visual question requires first recognizing the entity in the image and then recalling knowledge about it. Thinking vision-language models (VLMs) reason for thousands of tokens before answering, yet it remains underexplored how well such thinking VLMs perform each of these two steps. We therefore analyze thinking VLMs on this task and make two key observations. (1) Recognition is the bottleneck, since 76.3% of errors across four models on ViQuAE stem from misrecognizing the entity, and 84.9% of these failures are resolved once the entity name is provided in the question. (2) Recognition is driven by entity-recall clues rather than by general descriptions of the image. An entity-recall clue is a distinctive visual detail that helps the model recall the entity, such as keys, a traditional attribute of Saint Peter. Based on these findings, we propose ClueRL, a reinforcement learning approach that extends Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with an advantage localized to the entity-recall clue in the thinking trace. Rather than injecting new entity knowledge, ClueRL changes how VLMs think: it leads them to attend more closely to visual details and spot these clues, helping them use the knowledge they already have. Consequently, it outperforms both GRPO and a perception-reward baseline on three entity recognition benchmarks. Moreover, this clue-seeking behavior generalizes beyond entity recognition, the only task used for training. Since recognition is the bottleneck, the gains carry over to knowledge-based visual question answering. They even extend to general multimodal reasoning, raising Qwen3.5-4B by 4.4 and 4.0 points on the ScienceQA and MMMU subsets of MMStar, respectively.

AI.brief_summary: 论文拆解知识型视觉问答为「先识别实体、再回忆知识」两步，发现 thinking VLM 的错误主要源于实体识别失败，且识别依赖「实体回忆线索」这类独特视觉细节而非整体场景描述；据此提出 ClueRL，在 GRPO 中把优势定位到思考轨迹里的线索片段，引导模型关注细节、用已有知识作答，并在实体识别、知识型 VQA 与通用多模态推理上取得提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉证据筛选、THINK/LOOK 的收益成本分析以及轨迹训练中的贡献分配直接相关；其线索级的优势定位和失败归因可供核查是否也能解释内部状态中的细节保留与信息坍缩，但需注意它属于训练期方法，并未研究推理期的 latent 状态生成。
